title: Analyzing Fairness of Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring fairness metrics such as Demographic Parity Difference, Equalized Odds Difference, and Statistical Parity Difference using the Fairlearn and AIF360 libraries across gender groups in both computer vision (facial analysis) and NLP (medical review classification) models.

Calculating fairness and disparity metrics (e.g., Demographic Parity Difference, Theil Index) across distinct age brackets using fairness libraries to evaluate biases in facial analysis and text-based medical decision predictions.
Evaluating demographic disparities in a computer vision model by computing group fairness constraints (e.g., Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds) on the UTKFace dataset using ethnicity labels.
